visualCharacteristics.structure: 3-up grid of linked tiles: background image + H3 title + arrow cue
visualCharacteristics.description: Three equal tiles. Photo tiles have a dark-blue tint over a full-bleed photo with a white H3 at top-left. An icon tile (SVG/PNG image) has a solid medium-blue background, the icon top-left and the H3 at the bottom. Each tile has a white right-arrow at bottom-right and the whole tile is clickable.

contentPattern.structure: Repeating rows of [image] | [H3 title wrapped in a link]; 3 tiles per block instance. Icon tiles are detected from the image file type (SVG/PNG).
